_doc: State of the main (default) resume behind the home page's Download PDF button. Written by the update-main-resume skill; do not hand-edit except to repair it. source: the HTML the PDF is printed from. publicPath: the file under public/ that data/header.json resumePdfPath points at; its basename is the name a visitor's download is saved as. pages: the page count the validator expects. spacingMultiplier: the --m value it was printed with. reviewedThrough: the commit whose data/ the resume was last reconciled against; the next run diffs data/ from here. updated: date of the last build.
